research.topic: Country with the most islands: Sweden, about 267,570 islands (Statistics Sweden, 2013 count, islands ≥ 25 m²), of which about 1,000 are inhabited. Indonesia has about 17,000 (17,504 per the Geospatial Information Agency / official UN submission); the Philippines 7,641 (NAMRIA). Stockholm is built on 14 islands. Most Swedish islands are skerries, small bare rocks; post-glacial rebound lifts the land several millimetres a year and new islands emerge.
